title: Boom!
content: I had a dream last night where I litetally said "this is the mall world" lol Ill try to explain it without giving too many of the little details. Started off me and an old coworker of mine wetr riding this gocart thing that looked pretty much just like an engine to a go cart. We go down a dirt road and end up in this small house. Inside the house there was cash. I end up grabbing a bunch of 5 dollar bills and sticking them in my pocket. (Which is odd because im nkt a theif in real life) Then the owner pulls up and its a little person. He looks like peter dinklage and he is a construction worker. He comes in and confronts us. We make up some BS and try to leave. He follows us and tries to fight us but then he gets scared and turns back. My coworker leaves and goes a different direction and i start walking down this highway. Behind me there is a massive explosion. So i start to run. I end up in a mall. I got to hide in this bathroom/locker room and in there is the little person. He has his hair dyed blue and soot all over his face. The police show up and arrest him. He says that he is tired of getting pushed around so he blew his house up. The police question me and ask about what happened, I lie to them aboit being in the house and taking the money. The rest of the dream they are follwing me through the mall. I go to this outdoor section of the mall. I ask them why they are doing this and why everyone is here and they said they are training everyone here to do different things. I keep trying to get away and end up on this beach trying to get back to my house. At this point im semi lucid and realize im dreaming so i try to fly back to my house but im afraid of heights (irl) so i keep landing and walking on the ground. Never able to get away from the mall.
